title: Greenwood's journal, late 1949: Manny's, Bergen, Campbell's
summary: Allen reads journal dates for Manny's, Stuart Bergen at a fraternity party and a Campbell's visit; Steinau recalls his roommate who told him of the record shop.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
